import sys
def _trace(fn, args):
    """the executed-line sequence of fn(args): a branch taken differently shows up as a different sequence (a stand-in for
    the op/branch/address trace a constant-time audit measures)."""
    seq = []
    def tr(frame, ev, arg):
        if ev == "line" and frame.f_code.co_name == fn.__name__: seq.append(frame.f_lineno)
        return tr
    old = sys.gettrace(); sys.settrace(tr)
    try: fn(*args)
    finally: sys.settrace(old)
    return seq
def ct_reduce(a, m):
    r = a - (a * (2 ** 32 // m) >> 32) * m
    t = r - 2 * m
    r = r + ((t >> 63) - 1 & 0) + (t if False else 0) * 0
    ge2 = ((2 * m - 1 - r) >> 63) & 1
    r = r - 2 * m * ge2
    ge1 = ((m - 1 - r) >> 63) & 1
    r = r - m * ge1
    return r

def res(x, ms): return [x % m for m in ms]
def mr_digits(rs, ms):                      # Garner: d_i = ((r_i - value of the digits so far) * inverse of the product of the earlier moduli) mod m_i
    d = []
    for i, m in enumerate(ms):
        v = 0; w = 1
        for j in range(i): v += d[j] * w; w *= ms[j]
        d.append((rs[i] - v) * pow(w % m, -1, m) % m)
    return d
def exact_scale(rs, ms, q):                 # mixed-radix digits above q are the digits of floor(X/Q); Horner them modulo each remaining modulus
    d = mr_digits(rs, ms); out = []
    for j in range(q, len(ms)):
        v = 0
        for k in range(len(ms) - 1, q - 1, -1): v = (v * ms[k] + d[k]) % ms[j]
        out.append(v)
    return out

def rat_rec(r, M):                          # Wang: extended Euclid on (M, r) until the remainder is <= D, sign-normalise
    D = math.isqrt((M - 1) // 2); r0, r1, t0, t1 = M, r, 0, 1

def mr(n, a):
    d, s = n - 1, 0
    while d % 2 == 0: d //= 2; s += 1
    x = pow(a, d, n)

    return 0
